text:
Race @GoogleMaps Pegman through Tokyo's Shibuya Scramble Crossing to reach the Google building 🏃

Built with Gemini 4 Neon, this 3D runner turns nearly 1M tokens of real OpenStreetMap data (654 roads, 70 rail lines, and 280 building footprints) into a playable arcade map with https://t.co/DEHsqYbsdm
